auditAuthorizationSuccess.description: Flag that indicates whether someone set auditing to track successful authentications. This only applies to the `"atype" : "authCheck"` audit filter. Setting this parameter to `true` degrades cluster performance.

auditFilter.description: JSON document that specifies which events to record. Escape any characters that may prevent parsing, such as single or double quotes, using a backslash (`\`).

configurationType.description: Human-readable label that displays how to configure the audit filter.

enabled.description: Flag that indicates whether someone enabled database auditing for the specified project.
